The river that ranks **third in the world by average discharge** is the **Yangtze River**.  
It flows **entirely within China** – from its source in the Tibetan Plateau to its mouth on the East China Sea.

| Rank | River | Main countries it traverses |
|------|-------|-----------------------------|
| 1st | Amazon | Brazil, Colombia, Peru, etc. |
| 2nd | Congo | Democratic Republic of the Congo |
| 3rd | **Yangtze** | **China** |

So, the third‑largest river by discharge is in **China** only.
